name: joint-multilayer-bs10-diagnostic-v1

source.policy: first 500 eligible fresh-subject records after ordinal 8999; preserve source order

arm_semantics.NATIVE: native five-layer AlphaEdit continuation, no new functional guard
arm_semantics.JOINT_STEP: joint writer; fixed original/valid-target references; reset functional bounds to batch-entry risk plus epsilon
arm_semantics.JOINT_CUM: same joint writer; base bound fixed at trajectory entry, history bounds fixed at initial entry or acceptance

geometry.key_side: A_l = solve(P_l @ (K_l @ K_l.T + M_l) + 10 I, P_l @ K_l)
geometry.basis: Q_l = orth(A_l), thin SVD with relative singular cutoff 1e-6
geometry.history: accepted final endpoint: all five native post-write batch key Grams appended once

objective.edit_guard: each of 10 requests: mean target NLL across six native contexts <= 1.0 nat/token; canonical mean target NLL <= canonical mean original-answer NLL
objective.bound_calibration: predeclared diagnostic settings; no outcome-driven retuning or budget expansion

joint_solver.optimizer: inequality augmented Lagrangian with descent line search and fixed total trust region
joint_solver.primal_direction: negative full joint gradient normalized by max(global L2 norm, 1e-12)
joint_solver.trial_projection: project full concatenated V to radius 0.01; use projected displacement in Armijo test
joint_solver.line_search_failure: record and end current primal round; continue fixed dual/round budget
joint_solver.multiplier_state: warm-start base/history multipliers in both joint arms; current-edit multipliers reset
joint_solver.working_history: all 16 old control items plus up to 32 accepted new items with least constraint slack
joint_solver.full_history_guard: all old control items and every previously accepted new canonical request, after each round
joint_solver.outcome: smallest-energy actually feasible candidate; no feasible candidate => atomic reject all 10
joint_solver.rejection: W/M/history anchors roll back; advance to next offered batch without replacement; retain best dual estimates separately
joint_solver.repeats: no retry with another layer or relaxed bound
joint_solver.microbatch: allowed for full-loss gradient accumulation; never 10 sequential singleton commits

native.finite_failure: keep native update and history; record failed acquisition
native.technical_nan: stop that trajectory; preserve last finite state within snapshot cap

panels.new_history_control: all accepted new canonical records; gradients use active subset, acceptance scans all
panels.new_history_observer: two held-out paraphrases per offered edit; no PS gradients or selection
panels.preservation_scope: functional constraints cover control pool, not all archived 1k/5k/9k edits

measurements.per_batch: current acquisition + acceptance/failure + control risks/slack/duals + per-layer updates/key-response traces + solver costs
measurements.milestone: fixed observer before last write and after; all offered continuation canonical/PS; current neighborhood
measurements.quality_caveat: teacher-forced pair/strict and free-generation metrics remain separate

weight_snapshots.reconstruction: pinned original model plus all five saved MLP down_proj weights
weight_snapshots.metadata: source checkpoint SHA, weight SHA, offered/accepted IDs, references/anchors/duals, config/code/runtime/context identities
weight_snapshots.validation: independent CPU copy, atomic save, tensor reload equality, full-model output parity, all other weights unchanged
weight_snapshots.technical_early_stop: last finite snapshot replaces next scheduled snapshot; at most two per trajectory

damage_interpretation: BS10 and 500-edit continuations create a stress condition; larger damage than BS1 is not guaranteed
comparison_limit: STEP grants epsilon again each batch, CUM does not: unequal total allowance is intentional; lower damage alone is not routing superiority

damage_markers.usage: descriptive onset only; never stopping or tuning criteria
